messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Esperanto, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Esperanto line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Kaj ŝi ne moviĝis antaŭ mia vizaĝo, Anstataŭe ŝi obstinis tiom mian vojon, ke por reveni mi ofte turniĝis.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (locked meaning) | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (to English) | Status | |-------------|----------------------------------------|----------------------|--------------------------------|--------| | e | coordinating conjunction linking the clause | **Kaj** | “and” | OK | | non | negation of the following predicate | **ne** | “not” | OK | | mi | clitic pronoun that participates in the reflexive construction (the “she” who does not move) | **ŝi** | “she” | OK | | si | reflexive marker of the verb *partire* | — (reflexivity encoded in **moviĝis**) | — | UNNECESSARY | | partia | imperfect of *partire* “to move, depart” (negated) | **moviĝis** | “moved / was moving” (reflexive) | OK | | dinanzi | preposition “in front of, before” | **antaŭ** | “before / in front of” | OK | | al | preposition required by *dinanzi* (“in front of **to**”) | — (absorbed by **antaŭ**) | — | UNNECESSARY | | volto | noun “face” | **vizaĝo** | “face” | OK | | anzi | contrastive adverb “nay, rather” | **Anstataŭe** | “instead, rather” | OK | | ’mpediva (impediva) | imperfect of *impedire* “to hinder” | **obstinis** | “hindered” | OK | | tanto | degree adverb “so, to such an extent” | **tiom** | “so much / to that degree” | OK | | il | definite article “the” (masc. sing.) | — (Esperanto has no article) | — | UNNECESSARY | | mio | possessive adjective “my” | **mian** | “my” (accusative) | OK | | cammino | noun “road, path” | **vojon** | “road / path” (accusative) | OK | | ch’ (che) | subordinating conjunction “that” | **ke** | “that” | OK | | i’ (io) | 1st‑person pronoun “I” | **mi** | “I” | OK | | fui | past‑historic of *essere* “to be” (auxiliary) | — (past meaning carried by **turniĝis**) | — | UNNECESSARY | | per | preposition “for, in order to” | **por** | “for / in order to” | OK | | ritornar | infinitive “to return” | **reveni** | “to return” | OK | | più | comparative adverb “more” (used with *volte* → frequency) | **ofte** | “often” (frequency >1) | OK | | volte | noun “times” (frequency count) | — (frequency already expressed by **ofte**) | — | UNNECESSARY | | vòlto | past‑historic of *voltare* “to turn” | **turniĝis** | “turned (reflexively)” | OK |
### Items Not Marked **OK**
- **si** – unnecessary in Esperanto (reflexivity built into the verb). - **al** – unnecessary (preposition already covered by **antaŭ**). - **il** – unnecessary (Esperanto lacks definite articles). - **fui** – unnecessary (past tense expressed by the verb form **turniĝis**). - **volte** – unnecessary (frequency already conveyed by **ofte**).

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Esperanto script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Esperanto text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
